answer: A graduated escrow ladder resists sybils: every new identity starts at the nadir of trust, allowed only tiny tasks whose pay sits in escrow until peer-verified completion. Privilege rises only through a sequential, rate-limited history of good work, so one operator cannot simply echo the same cheap signup across thousands of fakes and cash out at dawn of a payout cycle. Each fake must separately grind through low-value work, paying time and verification fees per identity, while random audits slash escrowed earnings of cheaters.
